svg.title: IR02 Rotor Rev C
svg.text: IR02 Rotor drum Rev C with its 200 blocks (isometric, cut open)
Open (rear) end up, as on the magnet jig. A quarter is cut away so the five skewed rows can be seen.
Glue one row at a time, all 40
blocks of the row, N and S
Every block pulls hard: one at
a time, in the jig, never two.
